mainEntity.name: What is the closest alternative to Freshdesk?

acceptedAnswer.text: Zendesk is the closest broad help-desk comparison; Zoho Desk is worth checking for a smaller budget; Help Scout suits email-first teams. The right choice depends on channels, routing, AI usage and migration needs.

mainEntity.name: Is there a free Freshdesk alternative?

acceptedAnswer.text: Help Scout lists a free plan for up to five users, one inbox, one Docs site and 100 contacts per month. Zoho Desk lists a free edition for up to three users, and HubSpot Service Hub lists free tools for up to two users. Confirm current limits on official pages.

mainEntity.name: Can I move Freshdesk tickets to Help Scout?

acceptedAnswer.text: Help Scout's official import tool lists Freshdesk as a supported source on Standard, Plus and Pro. Test a sample and map fields before switching email forwarding or retiring the old help desk.

mainEntity.name: What should I compare besides price?

acceptedAnswer.text: Compare ticket fields, routing, SLA controls, portal and knowledge base, AI usage meters, reporting, export coverage, integrations and migration effort. A lower base price may not reduce total cost.
